title: Classic Chicken Wrap
description: A simple and delicious wrap filled with chicken, wrapped in a warm tortilla and served with a side of zesty sauce.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Grill the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm the tortilla wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by placing a few slices of chicken onto each tortilla, followed by shredded lettuce, cheese, tomato, and mayonnaise.
Drizzle the zesty sauce over the top of each wrap.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Slice the chicken into thin strips before serving.
If using, sprinkle shredded cheese over the top of each wrap before serving.
Garnish with additional lettuce, tomato, or mayonnaise if desired.
